name: ghost
label: Phosphor burn ghost
help: How strongly the last screen lingers. 0 is none.

name: ghost_decay
label: Ghost linger
help: How long the ghost takes to drain

name: ghost_rise
label: Ghost charge time
help: How long something must sit before it leaves a ghost

name: decay_g
label: Green fade
help: How long green light takes to fade

name: decay_r
label: Red fade
help: How long red light takes to fade

name: decay_b
label: Blue fade
help: How long blue light takes to fade

name: rise
label: Rise
help: How fast a new letter reaches full brightness

name: halation
label: Halation glow
help: Soft glow around lit text

name: beam
label: Beam swell
help: Bright strokes spread wider than dim ones

name: curv
label: Barrel warp
help: How far the glass bows

name: scan
label: Scanline depth
help: How dark the lines between rows are

name: scan_step
label: Scanline pitch
help: Pixels between scanlines

name: mask
label: Aperture grille
help: Vertical red, green and blue stripes

name: aberr
label: Colour split at the rim
help: Red and blue part company toward the edges

name: glare
label: Glass glare
help: The room's light on the glass

name: specular
label: Corner highlight
help: A small bright catch, upper left

name: vign
label: Corner falloff
help: Darker toward the corners

name: bloom
label: Centre wash
help: A faint tint of the tube's colour

name: glow
label: Tight glow
help: A two-pixel glow on every stroke

name: tracking
label: Tracking bar
help: Strength of the bar that rolls down the screen

name: track_bend
label: Bar bends the picture
help: How far the bar pushes the picture sideways

name: track_noise
label: Bar static and tearing
help: Line tearing and static inside the bar

name: track_chroma
label: Bar colour split
help: Colours part company inside the bar

name: band_h
label: Bar height
help: How tall the bar is

name: track_sweep
label: Seconds per pass
help: How long the bar takes to cross

name: track_rest
label: Seconds between passes
help: Quiet time before the next bar

name: jiggle
label: Screen jiggle
help: The picture breathes and now and then hops

name: flicker
label: Flicker
help: Occasional stepped dips in brightness
